study: M8 historical player-pair co-appearance cohesion vs Crown AH

methodology.feature: prior 365-day co-start pair recurrence, >=2/3 co-start exposure, normalized pair entropy, top-decile pair concentration, last-five lineup pair pre-existing co-start familiarity and recent-vs-old change; per target date cutoff target date-3d; each team must have >=3 complete prior XI records.
methodology.independent_difference: R50 measured player-level overlap between previous two starting lineups. This experiment measures recurrence of player pairs across the trailing 365-day lineup network; it does not use target lineup.
methodology.model: fixed Ridge alpha 100, expanding year training, fold-local standardization, Gaussian integer goal difference using train residual RMSE; choose side with higher expected Crown AH net return; no EV/no-bet gate, no parameter search.
methodology.settlement: Crown T12 AH line and two decimal odds; quarter-lines split into two adjacent half-goal legs, half stakes.

actual_receipt_replay.feature_timestamp_status: retrospective game lineups have event dates but no first-publication/receipt timestamps; 2026 receipt feature age is itemized above
